source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The 2024 fix wrote autohide="false" because that platform generation needed a stored value. The accepted endpoint uses attribute presence/absence and xulStore persists the missing-attribute sentinel. Current tests expect -moz-missing followed by a newline for visible state. Use hasAttribute/toggleAttribute/removeAttribute for this converted autohide/checked flow and persist after either transition. Do not copy the older false string into current code or apply presence semantics to ARIA states, which still use explicit true/false strings. Menu-bar persistence tests open new windows as a restart proxy; changing one window does not immediately update other open windows.
title: Persist menu bar visibility using the current boolean-attribute contract
